rationale: No existing Alerts spec exercises list pagination or back-navigation state restoration. The closest matches only reference 'pagination' incidentally (prebuilt-template tab switch, 'page restored' log lines) and none assert the footer range or round-trip a detail page. This cross-cutting feature is anchored in Alerts (store-backed restore), so a new spec in the Alerts area is the correct home; it must be added to ci_matrix.json's Alerts run_files. SLO and Dashboard URL-backed variants share the pattern but belong in their own area specs and are noted as uncovered secondary areas in the test plan.
